opportunity: A function reached only through a function pointer has no call site of its own, so neither `protoorder` (callee to callers) nor `calleevote` (callers to callee) reaches it and its own body is all it has. The program declares it anyway: `qsort`'s fourth parameter is `int (*)(const void *, const void *)` and `signal`'s second is `void (*)(int)`. Over the campaign's 444 slices, 294 callback arguments name 114 distinct functions, 50 of which decbench scores; all 50 DWARF declarations are exactly the slot's signature, and 67 ground-truth parameters would move, 16 of them parameters kuna recovers no trace of.
test_name: 37 unit tests (slot table, run ledger, the redo bound (body-agrees, caller_changes, printed_the_return), the kept-statement vote (narrows_a_void_pointer), the arity/width/return refusals, the caller-read ledger, the narrow-return walk) + tests/stages/kuna-callbacktype.xml (two-pass negative control) + fourteen tests/cli probes over five fixtures (callbacktype_x86_64, callbacktype_refused_x86_64, callbacktype_width_x86_64, callbacktype_narrow_x86_64, callbacktype_forward_x86_64): the parks, off, --jobs, ten refusals, and a forwarding caller that keeps its type; see docs/features/callbacktype/default-on-evaluation.md (c)
inspiration: IDA's Hex-Rays applies the prototype of a known callback parameter to the function whose address is passed there; its type libraries carry qsort's `int (__cdecl *)(const void *, const void *)` and the decompiler propagates it through the argument.

deliberately_absent.__cxa_atexit: glibc's <stdlib.h> rewrites atexit(f) into __cxa_atexit(f, 0, __dso_handle) with f cast from void (*)(void), so the slot's declared void (*)(void *) would give every atexit handler a parameter its source never wrote
deliberately_absent.sigaction: its handler is a structure member, not an argument
deliberately_absent.qsort_r: glibc and musl pass the comparator fourth and its data pointer fifth; macOS and FreeBSD before 14 pass an opaque thunk fourth and the comparator fifth, and the imported name does not say which library the image links (0 of the 775 decbench binaries import it)
